purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: ESA sources establish a national survey authority with cadastral-map responsibilities and Ismailia-related survey/map coverage, including topographic sheets and state-property mapping. The examined sources do not establish a complete city parcel registry or anonymous parcel geometry service; a government gazette parcel sketch is location-specific and does not establish WUP-point coverage.
registryAssessment: The Egyptian Survey Authority documents a national role in cadastral maps and records; its Ismailia-related sources cover governorate/state-property/topographic maps, not an anonymous full-city parcel register or viewer. Local city registry coverage is not established by the reviewed evidence.
